name: application-slider-range-histogram
title: Slider Range Histogram
description: A dual-thumb range slider overlaid on a value-distribution histogram, so users can see where their selected range sits within the overall data spread.
useWhen: Filtering a dataset by a numeric range (price, date, rating count) where showing the underlying distribution helps users pick a meaningful range.
The bar heights communicate density — e.g. how many items fall in each bucket — alongside the selectable min/max bounds.
avoidWhen: You just need a plain min/max range without distribution context — the existing `range-inputs` slider is lighter-weight.
The data has no natural bucketing (e.g. a handful of discrete options) — a segmented control or checkbox list communicates that better.
responsiveBehavior: The histogram bars and track share the card's full width via flex-1 bars, so the whole control scales down proportionally on narrow viewports without changing bar count.
accessibility: Each thumb is a real role="slider" element with aria-label, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuenow so its position and meaning are announced.
Both thumbs are independently focusable via tabIndex=0 for keyboard range adjustment in a real implementation.
The selected range is also stated as visible text ("$120 – $480") next to the histogram, not conveyed by bar/track color alone.

variants.title: Price distribution
variants.description: A 28-bucket price histogram with a dual-thumb range slider selecting $120–$480, selected buckets highlighted to match the active range.
accessibility: Each thumb exposes its role, label, and numeric value range via ARIA slider attributes.

variants.title: Price distribution (Dark)
variants.description: Price distribution histogram and range slider adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Highlighted bars, track fill, and thumbs all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
